name: Job Interview
description: A formal conversation where a candidate answers questions about their skills, experience, and fit for a role

structure.body: Answers to interviewer questions with concrete examples
structure.closing: Thoughtful questions and expression of interest in the role

visual_aids.importance: Low (except for portfolio or technical demonstrations)
visual_aids.recommendations: Bring printed copies of resume or portfolio if relevant

best_practices: Research the company and role thoroughly
Prepare examples using the STAR method (Situation, Task, Action, Result)
Prepare thoughtful questions to ask interviewers
Listen actively and ask for clarification when needed
Follow up with a thank-you message

audience_expectations.engagement: Authentic, thoughtful responses with good listening
audience_expectations.content: Relevant experience and examples that demonstrate skills

behavioral.description: Focus on past experiences as predictors of future performance
behavioral.key_differences: Heavy emphasis on STAR method examples

technical.description: Assessment of technical skills and knowledge
technical.key_differences: May include demonstrations, whiteboarding, or problem-solving

case_interview.description: Problem-solving approach to a business scenario
case_interview.key_differences: Focus on analytical thinking and structured approach

preparation_checklist: Compile 5-7 concrete examples of relevant accomplishments
Practice delivery with a friend or coach
Bring copies of resume and portfolio if relevant
